readingPassage.content: Last month, Emma joined her school's Green Club because she wanted to help the environment. On Saturday morning, the club organised a clean-up in the park. First, the students collected rubbish. They sorted plastic bottles and old paper into separate bags so that the materials could be recycled. Then they made posters asking people to use reusable bags and not to drop litter. Emma felt proud when she saw how clean the park looked. The club plans to organise another clean-up next month.
readingPassage.translation: O‘tgan oy Emma atrof-muhitga yordam berishni istagani uchun maktabining Green Club guruhiga qo‘shildi. Guruh parkda tozalash tadbirini o‘tkazdi.
